changes: CreateProductUsage accepts one usage with explicit fields and no caller-provided id.
The database assigns the bigint product usage id returned in GetProductUsageResponse.
GetProductUsages returns project-scoped usages for a usage type.
GetOrganizationUsages returns organization-scoped usages across projects.
GetUsagesResponse is shared by both list RPCs.
UUID idempotency and duplicate counters are removed.
unchanged: Assistant delivery remains direct best effort gRPC without an outbox.
